brief: Two-storey brick house of 1856 built by a German communal society: square plan, low hipped roof with a centre chimney, plain segmental-arched windows and a deep hip-roofed front porch on turned posts added later; a big shade tree in the side yard. Record: 2 photos plus 4 measured drawing sheets.

facade.notes: the Keucherer House (Zoar OH, 1856): a two-storey brick house of the Zoar Separatists, a full porch with square posts, a spindle rail and lattice screens; a big bare tree and spruces; a garage behind; HABS 1930s

why.note: Zoar's German communal settlers built plain two-storey brick and frame houses
